import pygame
import random

# Initialize Pygame
pygame.init()

# Set up some constants
WIDTH, HEIGHT = 800, 600
TARGET_SIZE = 50
BULLET_SIZE = 10

# Set up some colors
WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
RED = (255, 0, 0)

# Set up the display
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))

# Set up the font
font = pygame.font.Font(None, 36)

# Set up the clock
clock = pygame.time.Clock()

class Target:
    def __init__(self):
        self.x = random.randint(0, WIDTH - TARGET_SIZE)
        self.y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT - TARGET_SIZE)
        self.speed = random.randint(1, 5)

    def move(self):
        self.x += self.speed

        # Handle edge case: target moves off the screen
        if self.x < 0 or self.x > WIDTH - TARGET_SIZE:
            self.x = random.randint(0, WIDTH - TARGET_SIZE)
            self.y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT - TARGET_SIZE)

    def draw(self):
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, RED, (self.x, self.y, TARGET_SIZE, TARGET_SIZE))

class Bullet:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.speed = 5

    def move(self):
        self.x += self.speed

        # Handle edge case: bullet hits the edge of the screen
        if self.x < 0 or self.x > WIDTH - BULLET_SIZE:
            self.x = random.randint(0, WIDTH - BULLET_SIZE)
            self.y = random.randint(0, HEIGHT - BULLET_SIZE)

    def draw(self):
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, WHITE, (self.x, self.y, BULLET_SIZE, BULLET_SIZE))

def main():
    running = True
    targets = [Target() for _ in range(10)]
    bullets = []
    score = 0

    while running:
        for event in pygame.event.get():
            if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
                running = False
            elif event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN:
                bullets.append(Bullet(event.pos[0], event.pos[1]))

        screen.fill((0, 0, 0))

        for target in targets:
            target.move()
            target.draw()

            for bullet in bullets:
                if (target.x < bullet.x + BULLET_SIZE and
                    target.x + TARGET_SIZE > bullet.x and
                    target.y < bullet.y + BULLET_SIZE and
                    target.y + TARGET_SIZE > bullet.y):
                    score += 1
                    bullets.remove(bullet)
                    targets.remove(target)
                    targets.append(Target())

        for bullet in bullets:
            bullet.move()
            bullet.draw()

        if len(targets) == 0:
            targets.append(Target())

        text = font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, WHITE)
        screen.blit(text, (10, 10))

        pygame.display.flip()
        clock.tick(60)

    pygame.quit()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
